name: 城墙塔工程

references.role: cold-steel hexagonal frame, dark interior and lighting

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production technology-tree icon for the strategy game World-122, named Wall Tower Engineering; no text inside the image.
Input images: Image 1 (defense_tower_engineering.png) is the exact cold-steel hexagonal badge frame, dark faceted interior, material and lighting reference ONLY. Image 2 (wall_tower_sand.png) is the building identity and geometry reference ONLY, not a background.
Primary request: create a dedicated unlock-technology emblem for the sand-masonry wall tower. Inside the same silver cold-steel hexagon, depict ONE tall square 2-by-2 wall tower in three-quarter isometric view, built of naturally weathered warm tan sandstone blocks. Preserve the recognizable tower from Image 2: two-storey vertical square mass, four sides of crenellated parapets enclosing a flat walkable roof deck, and the elevated side arched opening. This is a wall-walk fortification, not an automatic weapon turret.
Composition: the tower centered and large, occupies around 75 percent of the inner badge height, complete base and all battlements visible, balanced negative space. A single coherent tower, not four separate towers. The badge frame is upright, top and bottom pointed, with vertical left/right sides and a brushed silver beveled rim, identical visual scale and proportions to Image 1. Full outer border visible, roughly 12px transparent safety margin on a square 1024x1024 canvas. Charcoal faceted inset enclosed within the badge.
Materials and lighting: PBR-style textured sandstone and brushed cool silver steel, soft upper-left light, restrained contrast, crisp legible silhouette at small UI scale. No excessive gold, no neon stone, no decorative foliage.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha OUTSIDE the hexagonal frame only; the charcoal inner background remains opaque. Do NOT paint checkerboard squares, black or white outer backdrop, floor plane, or cast shadow outside the frame.
Avoid: cannon, gun, auto-turret, extra buildings, roofs, flags, characters, gears, separate emblems, text, letters, digits, watermark, cropping, missing frame corners.

finalization.note: Preserve genuine source alpha if present; otherwise remove only the generated checkerboard outside the measured badge frame. Reuse the project's badge normalization.

scope: Only the wall_tower_engineering iconPath changes; no costs, prerequisites, unlocks, building textures or technology version changes.
